title: Overview
text:
merlin is the universal command-palette and voice assistant in hax ecosystem. it implemented by <super-daemon> web component â a global singleton (globalthis.superdaemonmanager) that surfaces searchable palette of commands debounced, multi-step "program" engine. users open with alt+shift (or meta+shift on macos). persona name "merlin" appears prompts, ui copy, throughout codebase. used across haxcms (site operations, admin panels, page editing), body (content authoring), app-hax (the application shell). any part can register into single shared palette, those are filtered active "context" so user only sees what relevant.
this site documents schema/contract for two data structures plug option program ai agents human contributors build without reverse-engineering source.
core concepts
merlin has kinds registrable commands:

option static, command. list; selecting fires customevent (usually) closes palette. registered via superdaemoninstance.defineoption(option).
program dynamic, search-driven its entry row launches "program mode": an async function invoked search text, array option-shaped rows returns replaces top-level list. re-invoked (debounced ~150ms) every keystroke, results live-update as types. just whose eventname "super-daemon-run-program" value.program function.

the access pattern
merlin instance. get reference to like this:
import { superdaemoninstance } from "@haxtheweb/super-daemon/super-daemon.js";

// or, anywhere import:
const =
  globalthis.superdaemonmanager.requestavailability();
then commands:
superdaemoninstance.defineoption({ ... });
the registration call
defineoption(option) does light validation (requires value, title, eventname) then auto-builds index string option's other fields. pushes allitems. options be at time most element's firstupdated() or module load.
where runtime implementation lives
this spec documentation only. code consumes this schema lives webcomponents monorepo, primarily elements/super-daemon/super-daemon.js singleton), lib/super-daemon-ui.js/lib/super-daemon-row.js/lib/super-daemon-search.js, real factory modules under elements/haxcms-elements/lib/core/utils/*program.js.

title: Option Schema Reference
text:
required fields: title, value, eventname. 
required fields


title (string) â primary display label. used for alphabetical sort and exact-match priority boosting.
value (object) payload dispatched as the detail of customevent named by shape varies eventname.
eventname name when row is selected.




display search fields


icon (string, optional) icon (e.g. "icons:save", "hax:wizard-hat") rendered simple-icon-lite.
image image url in an alternative to icon.
textcharacter a single character or emoji icon/image "ð").
tags (string[], optional, default []) searchable keyword tags. also simple-tag chips row.
path "") breadcrumb-style location string "cms/admin/seo"). whole phrase split on /.
description extra text. indexed but not rendered.
priority (number, 0) weight. lower numbers higher. negative values boost prominence. exact title match forces -10000000.
more (lit-html templateresult, expandable <details> section row. only plain more added index.




visibility behavior fields


context (string | string[], "*") visibility scope. "*" means available every context. other common values: "cms", "hax", "admin", "logged-in", "community", ">" (developer mode), "/" (program list), platform feature names ("addpage", "uploadmedia", "outlinedesigner") that disappear haxcms settings disable feature. prefer array; matched substring.
inline (boolean, false) list option merlin invoked inline (slash empty block, :: token, rte toolbar button).
inlineonly inline; never global browse/search. implies inline, so dont set both.
externallink renders open-in-new-window (the opens external site).
hidden true, registered invokable machinename/shortcut excluded from browse/search results.




voice shortcut fields


voice falls back title) voice-command pattern hal-9000 speech layer, e.g. "(toggle) dark mode". parenthesized segments are optional words.
shortcut object, keyboard-shortcut metadata linking shared keyboardshortcutmanager registry. either registry id "cms-save") descriptor object. resolved shortcutlabel; both index.




auto-built fields (do yourself)


index auto) space-joined, de-duplicated, lowercased index derived tags/path/title/voice/more/context plus full path phrase.
shortcutlabel human-readable label keyboardshortcutmanager.getlabel() "ctrlâ§s", "###"). program result rows passed through defineoption(), wants key hint sets it directly.

title: Program Schema Reference
text:
a program is an option with eventname: "super-daemon-run-program" and value object containing the following keys. 
value fields


name (string, required) â human-readable name shown as program-mode title while active.
program (async (input, values) => promise<option[]>, search function. input current text; values bag passed into runprogram(). each returned item option-shaped row rendered by super-daemon-row. re-invoked (debounced ~150ms) on every keystroke.
machinename optional) stable identifier enabling runprogram(like', context, values, 'machinename') to resolve invoke this without holding direct function reference.
context command context activate when launches (e.g. "cms" or ">"). single string, not array: runprogram() assigns it straight commandcontext.
placeholder placeholder text for active "enter new title").
initialvalue (values) promise<string>, optional prefill: non-empty string return pre-fills launched no explicit like/search. currently only honored machinename; selecting from merlin passes directly skips it.



the whole also program's second argument (values), so any extra keys you put reach program.
the lazy factory pattern
programs are commonly lazy-loaded via dynamic import() of createxprogram(context) module, code fetched user actually selects it:
superdaemoninstance.defineoption({
  title: "update page tags",
 icon: "icons:label",
 tags: ["cms", "edit", "tags", "metadata"],
 "super-daemon-run-program",
 path: "cms/edit/tags",
 context: ["cms"],
 voice: "edit value: {
 name: machinename: "edit-tags",
 placeholder: tags separated commas",
 initialvalue: async const activeitem = tojs(store.activeitem);
 (activeitem && activeitem.metadata activeitem.metadata.tags) || "";
 },
 program: { createedittagsprogram } await import(
 "./utils/edittagsprogram.js"
 );
 createedittagsprogram(this)(input, values);
 },
});
the module exports that returns actual [...] function, closing over (typically haxcms-site-editor-ui instance) can call back editor methods.
what returns
the array rows. follows same schema common pattern "confirm" rows use "super-daemon-element-method" dispatch save event:
return [
 `save ${input}`,

 target: globalthis,
 method: "dispatchevent",
 args: customevent("haxcms-save-node-details", bubbles: true,
 composed: detail: id: activeitem.id, operation: "settags", }),
 ],
 },
];

programs be (not just search), superdaemoninstance.runprogram():

title: Event Contract & Context System
text:
event contract when a result row is selected, super-daemon-row.selected() always dispatches super-daemon-row-selected (with detail = the element), then customevent named option.eventname with set to option.value. for any eventname other than super-daemon-run-program, it also super-daemon-close close palette. program selections keep palette open so user can continue interacting.
the super-daemon singleton listens these events globally and routes them:

eventname routing table


super-daemon-element-method â calls value.target[value.method](...value.args). closes palette.
super-daemon-element-click synthetic mouseevent("click") on value.target. palette.
super-daemon-run-program hands value runprogram() enters mode. does not palette.
hax-super-daemon-insert-tag haxstore inserts block: fills waiting target properties.src/source/href, otherwise through tray (value: { value: tag, eventname: "insert-tag", demoschema: true } or properties, content }). palette.
execute-keyboard-shortcut haxcms-site-editor-ui resolves value.shortcutid in keyboardshortcutmanager runs it. palette.
disabled no-op. used informational rows like "no active page found". palette.
super-daemon-noop no-op instruction (no listener). palette.
anything else dispatched as plain customevent; you need your own listener. palette.



other (dispatch drive merlin from code):

other listened events


super-daemon-define-option treated an option registered via defineoption().
super-daemon-run-program ({ program, context, name, placeholder, values }) launches program.
super-daemon-element-method target, method, args invokes method target.
super-daemon-element-click clicks target.
super-daemon-close resets state.
super-daemon-program-enter programname, input handles enter pressed no filtered results (used by create-page program).
super-daemon-voice-command command, callback, context registers voice command.



context system
every declares string array of strings that determines visible. tracks commandcontext (a single string) (the contexts current page/app state provides). appears only its intersects set.

context values


* global available default omitted).
cms while haxcms site-editor context.
hax hax body editor (authoring) context.
admin admin/site-settings operations.
logged-in authenticated.
> developer mode special entered typing > palette.



the switches prefix character (/, *, >) into search input, ("run program" â /, "developer mode" >). "*" (global browse), options are against pages array; specific value, whose includes shown.

title: Voice & Shortcut Metadata
text:
voice command layer (optional facet) when voicesearch is enabled on the super-daemon element, hal-9000 speech engine loaded and merlins commands become voice-addressable. each option can declare a phrase pattern; if omitted, title used. pattern syntax uses parenthesized segments for optional words, e.g. "(toggle) dark mode" matches both "toggle "dark mode".
voice are re-processed (reprocessvoicecommands()) whenever visible item set changes (e.g. context switch), so only currently-relevant options built-in catch-all ("*anything") routes unrecognized into search input.
this â programs work fully without it. field purely additive.
shortcut metadata facet)
an (or program entry row) shortcut that links it to shared keyboardshortcutmanager registry single source of truth keyboard/insertion shortcuts across hax ecosystem. also used by haxcms ctrl+shift+[key] bindings haxstore markdown-trigger-to-gizmo map, merlin reference same descriptor those subsystems use.
shortcut accepts either id string "cms-save") resolves previously registered via keyboardshortcutmanagerinstance.register(...) or an inline object with canonical shape:
{
  id: "cms-save", // stable unique id
 type: "binding", 'binding' (modifier+key) | 'markdown' (typed trigger insert)
 key: "s", physical key (binding)
 ctrl: true, shift: alt: false, meta: binding modifiers
 trigger: "###", markdown (type: 'markdown')
 tag: "h3", insert target tag
 content: "", inner content
 description: "save page", human-readable
 context: "edit", 'edit' 'view' 'global'
 allowininput: whether fires while focus in input
 callback: function, direct callback condition: active-condition eventname: "super-daemon-element-method", event fire instead / alongside callback
}
when present, defineoption() human-readable label keyboardshortcutmanager.getlabel() stores shortcutlabel "ctrlâ§s" binding, "###" trigger). ui reads render keyboard hint row. excluded from index they don't pollute text matching.
real example (from haxcms-site-editor-ui.js):
superdaemoninstance.defineoption({
 title: this.t.save,
 icon: "icons:save",
 tags: ["cms", "save", "page"],
 shortcut: ctrl+shift+s binding
 value: { target: this, method: "_editbuttontap" },
 "hax",
 "super-daemon-element-method",
 path: "cms/action/save",
});
this additive does not change how invoked; surfaces keyboard-hint (optionally) ties cross-subsystem consistency.
